```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("instacart")

day_names =
  c("Sunday",
    "Monday",
    "Tuesday",
    "Wednesday",
    "Thursday",
    "Friday",
    "Saturday")

hour_labels =
  c("12 AM",
    str_c(1:11," AM"),
    "12 PM",
    str_c(1:11, " PM"))

orders =
  instacart |> 
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day, days_since_prior_order)
```

Column {data-width = 550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Number of Items per Instacart Order by Day of Week

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Box statistics come from every order, so the page doesn't need to embed
# over 100,000 data points. Whiskers extend to the most extreme values
# within 1.5 x IQR; points beyond that are not drawn.
instacart |>
  count(order_id, order_dow, name = "n_items") |>
  group_by(order_dow) |>
  summarize(
    q1 = quantile(n_items, 0.25, names = FALSE),
    med = median(n_items),
    q3 = quantile(n_items, 0.75, names = FALSE),
    iqr = q3 - q1,
    lower = min(n_items[n_items >= q1 - 1.5 * iqr]),
    upper = max(n_items[n_items <= q3 + 1.5 * iqr]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(day = factor(day_names[order_dow + 1], levels = day_names)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~day, q1 = ~q1, median = ~med, q3 = ~q3,
    lowerfence = ~lower, upperfence = ~upper, type = "box",
    fillcolor = "rgba(0, 40, 104, 0.35)",
    line = list(color = "#002868")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Items per order", rangemode = "tozero"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

Column {data-width = 450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Distribution of Days Between Customers' Instacart Orders

```{r, echo = FALSE}
orders |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~days_since_prior_order, type = "histogram",
    xbins = list(start = -0.5, end = 30.5, size = 1),
    marker = list(color = "#BF0A30", line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1))
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Days since prior order",
      tickvals = seq(0, 30, 5),
      ticktext = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30+")
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of orders"),
    bargap = 0.05
  )
```

### Instacart Orders by Day of Week and Hour of Day

```{r, echo = FALSE}
heat_counts =
  orders |> 
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day, name = "n_orders") |> 
  complete(
    order_dow = 0:6, order_hour_of_day = 0:23,
    fill = list(n_orders = 0)
  ) |> 
  arrange(order_dow, order_hour_of_day)

heat_matrix =
  matrix(heat_counts$n_orders, nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE)

plot_ly(
  x = 0:23, y = day_names, z = heat_matrix, type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(c(0, "#FFFFFF"), c(1, "#002868")),
  colorbar = list(title = "Orders")
) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of day",
      tickvals = 0:23, ticktext = hour_labels, tickangle = -45
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")
  )
```
